question.text: The area bounded by $y=x+1$ and $y=\cos x$ and the $X$ -axis, is

solution.text: We have, $y=x+1 \text { and } y=\cos x$ $\begin{aligned} \text { Require area } &=\int_{-1}^{0}(x+1) d x+\int_{0}^{\pi / 2} \cos x d x \\ &=\left[\frac{x^{2}}{2}+x\right]_{-1}^{0}+[\sin x]_{0}^{\pi / 2} \\ &=\left[(0)-\left(\frac{1}{2}-1\right)\right]+[1-0] \\ &=\frac{1}{2}+1=\frac{3}{2} \text { sq unit. } \end{aligned}$
